integrity_note: All universal assertions rest on the explicit singular-value decomposition and strict quadratic Schur test, with scalar boundary witnesses; finite checks are corroboration only. Earlier undamped PAPC 4/3 barrier is credited, not claimed as new.
scientific_limitations: Autonomous fixed-a APAPC with zero smooth gradient and isotropic strictly positive primal/dual quadratic curvatures; no claim for nonsmooth/nonlinear problems, finite-horizon monotonicity, accelerated behavior with nonzero smooth gradients, varying a, or all trajectories at the critical boundary.
title: Sharp dual-stepsize stability frontier for constant-parameter quadratic APAPC
